{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the dataset
penguins = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/penguins.csv')

# Check the number of missing values in flipper_length_mm
print("Number of missing values in flipper_length_mm:", penguins['flipper_length_mm'].isnull().sum())

# Compute mean flipper length by species, dropping rows with missing flipper length
mean_flipper_by_species = penguins.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Display the means
print("\nMean flipper length by species:")
print(mean_flipper_by_species)

# Find the species with the highest mean
highest_mean_species = mean_flipper_by_species.idxmax()

# Display the result
print(f"\nSpecies with highest mean flipper length: {highest_mean_species}")"}
